visualRule: Purpose-built diagrams, exact scalar ledgers and informative plots. common: Nonnegative terminal underlying and strike; matching maturity, exercise style and settlement. No dividends in simple parity/bounds. Frictionless unrestricted trades and safe borrowing/lending stated.

A direct supplied positive discount factor B prices one fixed remaining period. This is B=exp(−rT) in continuous-rate notation, with B<=1 equivalent to nonnegative rates; do not add an inconsistent independent maturity control. Exact rational original factors retain tiny signs and differences.

Use complete original binary64 rational arithmetic and independent Fraction/mpmath reference. No max(0,tiny) floors, numerical finite differences from rounded prices, fabricated market quotes, forecasts or copied original-paper assertions.

Constructed finite/state-price or triangular continuous Q laws are assumptions, not estimates. Continuous-density pricing is explicitly assumed beyond the finite FTAP prerequisite. Physical law can differ without changing Q prices.

lessons.model: Assume a constructed triangular Q density on[a,b] with modec strictlyinside. C(K)=B EQ(X−K)+. Exact expectation: E−K forK<=a; 0forK>=b; (b−K)^3/[3(b−a)(b−c)] forK>=c; E−K+(K−a)^3/[3(b−a)(c−a)] belowc, E=(a+b+c)/3. Density is2(K−a)/[(b−a)(c−a)] belowc and2(b−K)/[(b−a)(b−c)] above. Derive Cprime=−B survival and Csecond=B density; general laws require a measure not a classical density. Symmetric finite difference divided byBh^2 is a triangular-kernel average, not universally exact density; h0 uses analytic derivative with diagnostic undefined.

prototypeProgress.independentMethod: Exact Fraction integration of linear density segments rather than production closed-form tails;100-digit mpmath only for log formatting.
prototypeProgress.parameterDecision: Prefer direct supplied positive discount factor B for all one-period examples. This is the bond price B=exp(−rT), not an additional observed pricing fit. B<=1 corresponds to nonnegative rates. Fix one remaining period rather than adding an inconsistent independent maturity control. Exact Fraction arithmetic then retains parity/financing/curvature signs without introducing unnecessary transcendental approximations. Statements may show the continuous-rate formula as a convention with explicitly supplied B.
